These server settings will be changed and reloaded for all players:
%1

IGUI_MSH_Code_ECONOMY_UNAVAILABLE: The Minidoracat Economy is unavailable right now.
IGUI_MSH_Code_INVALID_PLAN: The Economy rejected this price plan.
IGUI_MSH_CodeAction_INVALID_PLAN: Fix the marked field and save again.
IGUI_MSH_Code_RESPAWN_DISABLED: This server doesn't allow respawning in safehouses.
IGUI_MSH_CodeAction_RESPAWN_DISABLED: Ask an admin to turn on the server setting SafehouseAllowRespawn.
IGUI_MSH_Code_NO_REPLY: The server didn't reply in time.
IGUI_MSH_CodeAction_NO_REPLY: Check your connection and try again.
IGUI_MSH_Code_TOO_FAR: That spot is too far away.
IGUI_MSH_CodeAction_TOO_FAR: Walk closer to the building and check again.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Menu: Check if this counts as indoors
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Head_NEED_ROOF: Not indoors: the roof isn't finished
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Head_PART_ROOF: Not indoors: only part of it has a roof
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Head_OPEN: Not indoors: there's a gap in the walls
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Head_CANOPY: Not indoors: this is only under a roof
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Head_MAP_ROOM: Indoors: this is one of the map's own buildings
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Head_BASEMENT: Self-built rooms underground never count as indoors
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_ROOM: It keeps you warm, out of the wind and dry.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_NEED_ROOF: Roof tiles still missing: %1. With even one missing, the whole room counts as outdoors.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_PART_ROOF: Wall off the part that has a roof, or put a roof over the whole enclosed area.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_OPEN: The roof keeps the rain off, but your body temperature follows the outdoors.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_CANOPY: Nothing encloses it, so your body temperature follows the outdoors. To make it indoors, close it in with walls, door frames or window frames.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_OUTSIDE: Go inside a building, or right-click the floor inside one and check again.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_MAP_ROOM: The map's own buildings follow the game's normal rules, so there's nothing to check.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Sub_BASEMENT: It stays dry underground, but your body temperature follows the outdoors.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_GapFix: Add a wall, door frame or window frame.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_DoorOpenFix: Not a wall while open: close it and check again.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_DoorShut: Door that isn't a wall · tiles: %1
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_DoorShutFix: Counted as a gap even when closed: some doors never count as walls, and some ways of opening or closing don't make the game recheck.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_SplitFix: Put a wall here to close off the part with a roof.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_HoleFix: Lay a floor on the level right above.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_ShowMarks: Mark the spots on the ground
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_ShowMarks_tooltip: A slightly darker floor shows the area that was checked; red floors are missing roof tiles and bright red walls are missing walls. They go away when you close this window.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Partial: The building is too big. Only the part nearest the checked spot was checked.
IGUI_MSH_Indoor_Note: Walls, door frames, window frames and fences all count as walls, even with a door in its frame left open or the glass removed; a house garage door doesn't count while it's open. The roof is the floor on the level right above.
